fields.task_id: Persistent logical task identifier shared across Chat, Work, Codex, and Git commits.
fields.task_description: Short human-readable description of the task.
fields.reasoning_level: When available from OpenAI usage data.
fields.routing_reason: Why the recommended model was selected.
fields.retries: Number of meaningful unsuccessful attempts before completion.
fields.commit_shas: Zero or more Git commit SHAs associated with the logical task.
fields.credits: OpenAI credits when reliably attributable; otherwise blank.
fields.notes: Optional evaluator notes, including later rework that changes the outcome assessment.

principles: Use the same task_id across surfaces when one logical task moves between Chat, Work, Codex, or Git implementation.
Do not infer credits from elapsed time or model list price when OpenAI usage data is not reliably attributable.
Do not treat a technically completed task as successful until the relevant validation or human review has occurred.
Preserve failed and escalated attempts so total cost is not biased toward only the successful final model.
